column1: # Where new files in Downloads go. The first matching line wins.
# Edit freely: the sorter rereads this file every time it runs.
#   kind      "from" matches the website a file came from (and its subdomains),
#   match     website names or extensions, separated by spaces
#   folder    folder inside Downloads, or a full path starting with ~ or /
#   only      optional: extensions a "from" line applies to
# Files still downloading, hidden files and folders are never touched.
# Nothing is ever deleted: installers go to the Trash after a week, and
# anything left loose in Downloads moves to Archive/<year-month> after 30 days.
